exposure: Breastfeeding promotion intervention (healthcare provider training, interpersonal communication and support, behavior change communication materials, mobile phone and mass media messaging, WhatsApp support groups)
Discussion of breastfeeding with a private health provider
Receipt of text or WhatsApp messages about breastfeeding
Participation in a WhatsApp breastfeeding support group
cohort: A cohort of 1200 women clients of private health facilities in Lagos, Nigeria, interviewed during their third trimester and at 6 and 24 weeks postpartum.
finding: The breastfeeding promotion intervention significantly increased exclusive breastfeeding at 6 weeks and 24 weeks, but had no impact on early initiation of breastfeeding.
